title: Snail holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Snail body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='78' rx='30' ry='12' fill='#8BC34A'/>
  <!-- Snail head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='66' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#9CCC65'/>
  <!-- Eye stalks -->
  <line x1='68' y1='58' x2='64' y2='42' stroke='#8BC34A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='57' x2='79' y2='41' stroke='#8BC34A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='3' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M68 70 Q72 74 76 70' stroke='#33691E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Shell -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='18' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='13' fill='#FFAB91'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='8' fill='#FFCCBC'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- Shell spiral line -->
  <path d='M35 46 Q48 46 48 58' stroke='#E64A19' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Arm holding heart -->
  <path d='M76 72 Q86 68 80 58' stroke='#8BC34A' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M80 54 C78 47 70 47 70 54 C70 60 80 66 80 66 C80 66 90 60 90 54 C90 47 82 47 80 54 Z' fill='#F44336'/>
  <!-- Heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FF8A80' transform='rotate(-20 77 52)'/>
  <!-- Foot base -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='88' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#7CB342'/>
</svg>
